Jensen Huang and the Cult of the Male Tech Founder

Even by Silicon Valley's standards, Jensen Huang’s scandals were outlandish. Huang resigned two weeks ago following reports that he had an affair with tech executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy whose company was suspected of steering restricted advanced AI chips to the country.
